column1: # Discriminator pins for sibling skill descriptions (issue #2244).
# Regexes are Python, case-insensitive, matched with re.search against the
# full description; anchor with ^ to pin the head. A pin is changed on
# purpose, in the same commit as the description it pins: if a rewrite needs
# a different discriminator, edit the pin and say why in the commit body.
# Cluster 4: commit -> push -> PR (git-plugin). All nine are auto-only
# (user-invocable: false), so they compete with each other on the router
# surface. Each of git-commit / git-push / git-pr leads with its scope limit,
# the convention references say they make nothing, and no sibling carries
